SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM videos v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM library_video_memberships m
  JOIN media_libraries l ON l.id = m.library_id
  WHERE m.video_id = v.id AND m.is_hidden = 0 AND l.status = 'active') AND (v.code LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR v.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR EXISTS
        (SELECT 1 FROM video_actress va JOIN actresses a ON a.id = va.actress_id WHERE va.video_id = v.id AND a.main_name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\'))

sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM videos v WHERE v.id IN (
      SELECT m.video_id FROM library_video_memberships m
      JOIN media_libraries l ON l.id = m.library_id
      WHERE m.is_hidden = 0 AND l.status = 'active'
    ) AND (v.code LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR v.title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR v.id IN (
        WITH matched_actresses AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT a.id FROM actresses a WHERE a.main_name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\'
        )
        SELECT va.video_id FROM matched_actresses matched
        CROSS JOIN video_actress va ON va.actress_id = matched.id
      ))

plan.detail: SEARCH v USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
SEARCH m USING COVERING INDEX idx_library_video_memberships_recent (is_hidden=?)
SEARCH l USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
SCAN a USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_actresses_1
